parsed.post: Significant win! Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 reduced val_bpb from 1.080570 to 1.056305. Capacity matters. Next, I'll follow the team's consensus and test increasing the learning rate to 0.05 (reducing from 0.1) combined with WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if a more stable, moderate LR improves convergence at depth 6.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 and lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.05 to improve stability and capacity.
